lesson.uz:
Funksiya takror ishlatiladigan vazifani nom bilan ajratadi. Parametrlar kirish qiymatlari, return variable esa natija. Main ichida natijani F(a,b) kabi ifoda orqali oling.
Funksiyaga faqat kerakli parametrlarni bering. Mahalliy o‘zgaruvchilar boshqa funksiyaga avtomatik ko‘rinmaydi. Bu mavzuda hisobni alohida funksiyada bajaring; Main kiritish va chiqarish bilan shug‘ullansin.
lesson.en:
A function names a reusable operation. Parameters supply input and the return variable holds its result. In Main, call it in an expression such as F(a,b).
Pass only the needed parameters. Local variables are not automatically visible in other functions. Put the calculation in a separate function; let Main handle input and output.

text.uz: Shartdagi talab etilgan bloklarga e’tibor bering.
text.en: Check the required blocks in each task.

text.uz: Har bir Input alohida qatorni o‘qiydi. Natijani namuna bilan taqqoslang.
text.en: Each Input reads one line. Compare your output with the examples.

statement.uz: Maktab do‘koni: Calculate(a,b) nomli Integer qaytaruvchi funksiya yarating: buyum narxi a va soni b uchun jami narx. Main ikki qiymatni o‘qib, funksiyani chaqirsin va natijani chiqarsin.
statement.en: School shop: Create an Integer-returning function Calculate(a,b) for the total cost for price a and quantity b. Main reads both values, calls the function and prints its result.

outputFormat.uz: So‘ralgan natijalarni berilgan tartibda, har birini alohida qatorda chiqaring. Qo‘shimcha matn chiqarmang.
outputFormat.en: Print the requested results in order, one per line, with no extra text.

statement.en: Sports centre: Create an Integer-returning function Calculate(a,b) for the total over 4 days for daily amounts a and b. Main reads both values, calls the function and prints its result.
